title: Liapoldus Gateway bootstrap gateway.yaml
description: Минимальная конфигурация единственного Core control-plane process. Plugin settings и traffic configuration хранятся Core в SQLite и доставляются по pluginprotocol ConfigApply.

fileReference.description: External file reference; inline secret values are forbidden.

path.description: Local SQLite database file path; network filesystems are not supported.
Local immutable plugin package/release store root for supervised mode.

profile.description: One global lifecycle profile for this single Core instance.

clientCA.description: Required for web Controller non-loopback access; desktop uses restricted SSH forwarding to loopback.

tls.description: Management TLS identity is required for every bind. Web Controller traffic additionally uses client mTLS and Bearer service credential.

url.description: TUF metadata endpoint only; install requests select a signed publisher/name/version and cannot supply an arbitrary URL.

pluginCatalog.description: Optional for external profile; required when supervised profile installs packages. The first-party trust root ships with Core.

x-liapoldus-invariants: Gateway Core is a single process and SQLite is the only durable source of desired plugin configuration.
The global execution profile is supervised or external; profiles cannot be mixed within one Core.
Plugin settings are not accepted in gateway.yaml, environment variables, argv, or plugin application-config files; Core pushes versioned JSON with ConfigApply.
Traffic listeners, sites, routes, and traffic-plugin runtime configuration are not part of gateway.yaml.
Traffic plugins own their runtime state on persistent local storage; Core remains implementation-agnostic.
Supervised installation verifies TUF metadata, package digest, platform and protocol compatibility; arbitrary package URLs are rejected.
External profile does not expose plugin install/start/stop/restart endpoints; process lifecycle belongs to the external operator.
Management TLS is always enabled. Management and plugin workload trust roots are separate.
SQLite, Core package paths, and plugin-owned runtime state use persistent local storage.
Plaintext secret values are forbidden in gateway.yaml and ConfigApply payloads.
